- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bordeaux Wine Festival is held in June every two years and attracts thousands of visitors from over 80 appellations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fête de la Fleur is an annual event marking the start of the grape harvest, featuring a grand ceremony and wine tastings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Vignoble en Fête celebrates the summer harvest season with wine tastings, food stalls, music, and grape-stomping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] La Fête du Vin Nouveau symbolizes the start of the autumn wine harvest with parades, fireworks, and regional wines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Le Weekend des Grands Crus is held every two years in May and showcases the best wines of Bordeaux's grand crus.
